skipButton.title: Skip
skipButton.note: Button shown over a YouTube video while a sponsored segment plays; tapping it jumps past the segment. Keep it short: it sits between two small icons.

undoSkipButton.title: Undo Skip
undoSkipButton.note: Same button, shown for a few seconds after a sponsored segment was skipped automatically; tapping it goes back to the start of the segment. Keep it short: it sits between two small icons.
